item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-19 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milan
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/ICHI-02 Impianti e processi industriali chimici

The research activities will include literature reviews, simulation and mathematical modelling, as well as experimental measurements related to catalytic and/or biological processes for the synthesis of low-carbon fuels. The literature review will focus on catalytic and biological processes for the production of renewable fuels. item.title: Incarico post-doc: Determination of Mercury’s gravity field from radio-metric data of the spacecraft BepiColombo and MESSENGER (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-03 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/IIND-01 Ingegneria aerospaziale e navale

The research activity will focus on the data analysis of the MORE (Mercury Orbiter Radio science Experiment) investigation on board ESA’s (European Space Agency) BepiColombo probe during the first year of the mission’s orbital phase. The activity will include regular orbit determination of the spacecraft and the analysis of Doppler and range data to measure Mercury’s gravity field, also including in the analysis the non-gravitational acceleration measurements from the ISA accelerometer and the radio tracking data acquired by NASA’s MESSENGER mission

item.title: Incarico post-doc: Development and fine-tuning of experimental methods based on image analysis for the analysis of steady and unsteady flows (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-03 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/IIND-01 Ingegneria aerospaziale e navale

The research activity involves the design and development of innovative measurement systems based on image analysis, for measuring both velocity and temperature fields in experimental fluid-mechanics. The focus is on non-invasive measurement techniques such as Particle Image Velocimetry (PIV) and Thermal Imaging (TI). In particular, the aim is to study fluid fields using cameras with innovative Event-Based sensors, for both hydrodynamic and aerodynamic flows. Engineering applications will include internal flows in micro-channels, for the study of heat transfer, the turbulent jets, for the investigation of multiphase dynamics and external flows for studying wakes of models in wind tunnel

item.title: Incarico post-doc: Digital Twin Development and Data-Driven Algorithms for Plant Health Estimation in EcoSentinel Systems (Univ. TRENTO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-28 12:00
Institution: Univ. TRENTO, Trento
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/IINF-05 Sistemi di elaborazione delle informazioni

This research activity, carried out within the European EcoSentinel project, focuses on the definition and implementation of a Plant Digital Twin dedicated to monitoring and diagnosing plant health. The candidate will develop data-driven models and machine learning algorithms capable of integrating and processing heterogeneous signals generated by the EcoSentinel platform. Specifically, the research involves analyzing inter-plant communication metrics (such as received signal strength / RSSI and transmission parameters) alongside energy harvesting data from microbial soil processes, aiming to infer plant health indicators (good, warning, danger states) and environmental soil conditions.

Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/IIND-02 Meccanica applicata alle macchine

The research activity focuses on the development and validation of simulation models to analyse the dynamic behaviour of wind turbines, with particular emphasis on floating wind turbines. The models will support the control of both individual turbines and the entire wind farm, with the aim of improving overall productivity. The research will also include the modelling of environmental loads, such as wind and wave fields, and their interaction with energy-generation systems.
